layers.name: L1
layers.combination_rule: dynamic latency/energy = max(DESTINY hierarchy result, Device Library data-bit floor); eDRAM read functions use the matching DESTINY result at Nrow; effective static and refresh power come only from the Device Library while raw DESTINY data/tag leakage is audit-only; endurance/density/variation/M3D come from Device Library

workload.description: OpenVLA/Llama-2-7B BF16 tiled self-attention behavior-level profile

semantics.leakage_unit: per data bit unless a model is named
semantics.greater_than_values: stored as a conservative numeric lower bound
semantics.edram_read_functions: evaluated by the matching DESTINY eDRAM instance at its configured Nrow
semantics.effective_static_power: SRAM uses the table leakage; MRAM/eDRAM are zero-static in this behavior-level model; eDRAM retention cost is counted only as refresh power
